items.text: Jalen Hurts (blood clots) is on IR and expected to miss the rest of the season; Tanner McKee starts. The schedule data still listed Hurts, so the model now uses McKee.
Philadelphia RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is nearing a return but not cutting yet; LB Nolan Smith Jr. is in the concussion protocol; RBs Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley are on IR.
